bifrost: springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (Manifest), springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (parse_manifest, install_archive), springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::with_entitlements, Policy::from_permissions, prepare_data), springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs (Bundle, set_main_bundle), springboard/ui/src/launch.rs (Handler), springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs, springboard/sdk/src/bundle_resources.rs (association file model); springboard/sdk/src/package_layout.rs (placement rules); springboard/sdk/src/container_layout.rs (container folders)
summary: BifrOSt covers the app package manifest, permission and entitlement gating, a fixed package layout with placement rules for libraries and plug-ins, a per-app container layout (created at launch since 2026-10-19), localized string bundles, a privacy declaration model, a model of domain association files for universal links, an info dictionary reader with CFBundle keys and InfoPlist.strings (bundle_info), and a general entitlements file with ML-DSA signing (entitlements). The shell and installer do not read the new info or entitlements files yet, and the universal links model is not yet fetched, verified or wired into the shell.

features.apple: Entitlements (com.apple.security.* keys in a signed entitlements file)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (Manifest.entitlements); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (Policy::with_entitlements); tests: springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-25.rs; springboard/sdk/src/entitlements.rs (Entitlements, KNOWN, sign, verify_signed)
features.note: The manifest entitlements list holds only log-store today; it is honoured only for is.olibuijr.* packages of kind system-app, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-25.rs. Built 2026-10-19: bifrost_app::entitlements reads a general entitlements plist (flags for the sandbox permissions and the first-party entitlements camera, screen, remote-desktop and log-store; lists for application-groups and keychain-access-groups), refuses unknown keys, wrong types, duplicates and oversized files, applies the first-party and system-app rules (check_for), lists the held names for the sandbox policy (held_names), and signs and verifies a canonical form with ML-DSA bound to the bundle id (sign, verify_signed). Gap: the shell does not read an entitlements file yet (Policy::with_entitlements still reads the manifest list), and there is no signing service or trust root, so no key is provisioned. Tests: inline entitlements.rs a_file_reads_flags_and_lists_sorted_by_key, unknown_keys_wrong_types_and_duplicates_are_refused, first_party_entitlements_need_a_first_party_package, the_log_store_entitlement_also_needs_the_system_app_kind, a_signed_file_verifies_only_for_its_key_and_its_package, a_changed_signed_file_is_refused_at_every_byte. Not compiled or run in this round. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> entitlements:: --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

features.feature: Information property list (bundle identity and configuration)
features.apple: Information Property List (Info.plist): CFBundleIdentifier, CFBundleVersion, CFBundleURLTypes, CFBundleDocumentTypes
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (Manifest, parse_manifest); springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (Manifest); springboard/docs/apps.md (Package section); springboard/sdk/src/bundle_info.rs (InfoDictionary)
features.note: manifest.toml carries id, name, version, exec, icon, min_shell, summary, category, permissions, window and kind. Built 2026-10-19: bifrost_app::bundle_info::InfoDictionary reads Info.plist (XML, binary or text form) or, without one, the top level of manifest.toml renamed to CFBundle keys, with accessors for identifier, name, versions, executable, icon, category and minimum system version, CFBundleURLTypes (url_types), CFBundleDocumentTypes (document_types, document_type_for_extension), per-language values from <lang>.lproj/InfoPlist.strings (localized, display_name), and validate() for missing or malformed identity keys. Files over 1 MiB are refused and the plist text readers stop at 128 nested levels (core/src/plist.rs). Gap: the shell and installer still read manifest.toml through their own parsers, and no package ships an Info.plist yet. Tests: inline bundle_info.rs manifest_keys_become_bundle_keys, an_info_plist_reads_the_same_accessors_and_url_types, document_types_match_extensions_and_content_types_and_rank_wins, translated_names_come_from_the_info_strings_of_the_package, hostile_info_files_are_refused, validation_names_each_problem; core plist.rs deeply_nested_text_forms_are_refused_instead_of_overflowing_the_stack. Not compiled or run in this round. Midget check: on Titan build the SDK unit-test binary with `cargo test --offline --profile fast -p bifrost-app --lib --no-run`, copy the executable it prints to Midget with `scp`, and run `ssh midget ./<that executable> bundle_info:: --test-threads 1`; every test passes.

features.apple: Placing content in a bundle: fixed locations for executables, resources, frameworks and plug-ins

features.apple: Container directories in the app sandbox (Library, Documents, Caches)
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (prepare_data); springboard/src/shell/apphost.rs (shell data dir as apps' asset dir); springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (document grants); springboard/sdk/src/container_layout.rs (ContainerLayout, Folder); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (prepare_container)
features.note: Each app gets a data directory owned by its account. Files outside it need a document grant from the shell. springboard/core/src/container_layout.rs models the Documents, Library, Library/Caches and tmp folders (backed-up and purgeable rules, relative path resolution that refuses escapes, and a creation step that refuses symlinks). Built 2026-10-19: app_policy::command now creates those four folders in the data directory at launch (prepare_container, before the ownership change so the account owns them); a data directory that already holds a file or link with one of those names skips the step so the app still launches. Apps still write the flat data directory, so nothing uses the folders yet. Not compiled or run in this round. Midget check: on Midget run `bifrost pc midget open-app <any sandboxed app id>` (for example the Notes app), then `ssh midget` and list the app's data directory (the path the shell passes to app_policy::command, under the shell's per-app data root): Documents, Library, Library/Caches and tmp exist and are owned by the app account, and the app still opens.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Reads <app>/<lang>.lproj/Localizable.strings with en fallback, as documented in docs/bifrost-ui.md. Built-in formatting data covers en and is only. No asset catalogs, storyboards or nib-style resources.

features.feature: URL schemes and document types declared by the app
features.apple: CFBundleURLTypes and CFBundleDocumentTypes in Info.plist; Launch Services handler registry
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/launch.rs (Handler::opens, Handler::scheme); springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs (builtin handlers); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (open); wired: springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs (manifest_handler, Email category)
features.note: The registry and default-app choice exist. docs/default-apps.md says open-url routing by scheme and the Open With menu are not done. Only http and https reach the browser through packaging/arch/wayland/open-url. URLType (CFBundleURLTypes: name, schemes, role, rank) parses in bundle_resources.rs and the launch service answers application_for_url (declaring app plus all candidates, user default first). No universal links. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: applinks: apple-app-site-association domain verification that routes https links to the app
features.note: Claims are read from a site association document (applinks.details appID or appIDs, wildcard paths) and host-tested in parity_sdk-complete-12.rs; exclusion paths are refused. Not wired into the shell or apps, and the document is not fetched or verified over https; no https link routing to a non-browser app, and the browser claims http and https by default (springboard/src/shell/defaultapps.rs builtin). Needs a Midget run with a live site for verification.

gaps: Privacy declarations are a model only: the shell does not load privacy.toml from installed packages, nothing shows it to people, and the store does not check it (springboard/ui/src/privacy.rs).

Universal links are not live: the association file is not fetched or verified over https, and the shell does not route https links to apps (springboard/sdk/src/bundle_resources.rs holds only the model).
bundle_info reads Info.plist and manifest.toml with CFBundle keys, but the shell and installer still parse manifest.toml with their own readers and no package ships an Info.plist.
URL-scheme routing by the shell is not wired for non-web schemes (docs/default-apps.md, Not done yet).
The entitlements file model is not read by the shell (Policy::with_entitlements reads the manifest list) and there is no signing service or trust root.

Apps still write the flat data directory although the container folders now exist (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs prepare_container); the package placement rules are a model that install_archive does not call (the SDK crate depends on the shell crate).
